name: J & B Auto Detailings LLC

reviews.text: So there I was, three Venti Pumpkin Spice Lattes in the passenger seat when a literal deer jumped out in front of me on academy sending 72 ounces of liquid onto the floor as well as all over the passenger side of Toyota Tundra. Called on Friday and Jesses was able to get me in the following Tuesday. I dropped my truck off at 8 AM and he had it done by about 2:30 PM. Interior and exterior. He did an absolutely phenomenal job. A unbelievable job and I cannot recommend him and this business enough. The wash/clay bar/ wax on the outside was beautiful as well but I forgot to take a picture. But you can see he worked wonders on the inside. Again, I cannot recommend his service enough.
reviews.author: Jd Taylor

reviews.text: If you need your car detailed, call J & B’s IMMEDIATELY.  They did miracle work on my 18 year old car that was in bad shape.  They did 2x the work in 1/2 the time.  I’m still shocked.
reviews.author: Kerry Holmes

reviews.text: I didn’t take before pictures because of how embarrassed I was at what the car looked like. But thanks to J&B Auto detailing the car looks brand new and smells so good! There were stains and mold in the carpets and seats. They were able to remove everything! They did an amazing job at an affordable price within a couple of hours! I was able to pic it up the same day! I’m so grateful!
reviews.author: Emma Sykes

reviews.text: Beyond impressed with what they were able to do with my dads car. This was in one days work. Completely nicotine stained, and a hot mess- now it looks like a different car! Reasonably priced, and very kind. Couldn’t recommend them more!
reviews.author: Lauren Farley

reviews.text: The first time Bill detailed my car I spilled hot coffee all over my suede seat. My seat dried up and became real hard. He worked his magic and cleaned the entire seat and my seat was back to normal. I just recently took my girlfriend’s car for a full interior detail and I still can’t believe how clean he got it. I’ll never let anyone else clean my car but Bill. Bill and his partners are truly the *hit!
reviews.author: Isaiah Howerton
